cluster_name.description: Name of the OCFS2 cluster. Must be unique within your network and match across all nodes.

number_nodes.description: Total number of nodes in the cluster. Must match the count of nodes listed below.

nodes.description: List of cluster nodes. Each node must be reachable by the other nodes via the specified IP address.

number.description: Node index (1-based, unique per node in the cluster).

ip_address.description: IP address used for cluster communication and heartbeating. Should be stable and dedicated if possible.

ip_port.description: TCP port used for O2CB communication. Keep as default (7777) unless conflicting.
